resources.string: Reminders are off, so Overgrown cannot tell you when a plant needs water or protection from weather.
Overgrown checks your plants once a day in the background. Some phones stop background work to save battery, and then reminders do not arrive.
Check the battery setting for Overgrown: set it to Unrestricted, or Don\'t optimise. In the list that opens, find Overgrown; on some phones this setting is under App info, Battery.
Some makers add their own battery savers. dontkillmyapp.com has the steps for each make of phone.
No app on this phone can open links.
